sentences.text: Certain lands in survey No.3/2 in Survey No.4/1A2, Hosahalli Village, Uttarahalli Hobli, Bangalore South Taluk has been acquired for the purposes of the petitioner- society.

On the ground that award is not passed and the compensation is not paid to respondent Nos.3, 4 and 5, claiming to be the erstwhile owners of the property acquired for the purposes of the petitioner-society, they made representations to respondent No.2 herein.

On the ground that no action was taken, on the representations, they filed Writ Petition No.11567/2022 and this Court has passed the following order in the said writ petition:
NC: 2024:KHC:31434 "7.

In view of the above, I pass the following:
ORDER a) Writ petition is disposed of.
b) Respondent No.3 is directed to consider the representation dated 07.05.2022 at Annexure-H, and second representation dated 21.05.2022 at Annexure-J within a period of 4 weeks from today strictly in accordance with law as per the available documents.
c) Respondent No.4 is also permitted to participate in the said proceedings and submit such documents to the respondent No.4 to enable the respondent No.3 to pass necessary orders.
d) Respondents to act on a print out of the uploaded copy of this order on the website of this Court, if so furnished by the petitioner, without waiting for certified copy thereof.
If respondents have any doubt about the order, respondents may verify the contents of the order form the website of this Court and or from the learned panel advocate appearing in the matter.
The QR code on this order could also be scanned to view the website of the High Court to verify the order."

In pursuance of the aforementioned order and the representations made by respondent Nos.3, 4 and 5 herein, respondent No.2 has issued the impugned notice to the parties concerned, which reads as under:

Aggrieved by the same, the present writ petition is filed.
3. It is the contention of the petitioner-society that respondent No.2 is required to act strictly in accordance with the order passed by this Court in Writ Petition No.11567/2022.

But he is exceeding his mandate and he is trying to act prejudicially against the interest of the petitioner-society.
4.

It is submitted for that reason, it is prayed that respondent No.2 be directed to strictly act in accordance with the order passed in Writ Petition No.11567/2022 and not to hear respondent Nos.6 to 8 who are not parties to the proceedings in Writ Petition No.11567/2022.
5.
The learned counsel for the respondent Nos.3 to 5 submits that they have no objections to allow the writ petition as prayed for.
However, learned AGA submits that notice to respondent Nos.6, 7 and 8 are also issued to have a better understanding about the case on hand.
It is submitted that the petitioner herein is a Cooperative Society and hence Registrar of Cooperative Society has been issued a notice.
The layout plan is said to be sanctioned by the Bangalore Development Authority (For short 'BDA') and hence notice has been issued to the BDA.
7. It is further apprehended that there may be law and order issue and for that reason notice is issued to respondent No.8.
On the said ground, it is prayed that the writ petition be dismissed.

4 8.

However, in the course of arguments, the learned AGA submits that though notices are issued to respondent Nos.6, 7 and 8, the scope of the enquiry will be limited as per the directions issued by this Court in Writ Petition No.11567/2022 and it will not be widened and NC: 2024:KHC:31434 orders will also be passed accordingly.
It is further submitted that if any irregularity is discovered and it warrants some action, it will not be ordered in the present enquiry and separate action will be initiated.

9. Admittedly, the impugned notice has been issued to implement the orders passed by this Court in W.P. No.11567/2022 and any enquiry in pursuance of the same cannot include things otherthan what is mentioned in the order passed in Writ Petition No.11567/2022 and respondent No.2 is required to limit his enquiry as per the said directions.

Hence, the following:
ORDER i. In pursuance of the impugned notice dated 29.04.2024 issued by respondent No.2 (vide Annexure-B to the writ petition) the enquiry and the order to be passed shall be limited to as per the directions of this Court in Writ Petition No.11567/2022.

ii. It is needless to state that if any other action is required to be initiated by respondent No.2 other than NC: 2024:KHC:31434 what is contemplated in the Writ Petition No.11567/2022, that shall be part of separate proceedings in the manner known to law.
iii. Writ petition is disposed of accordingly.
Sd/-
(M.I.ARUN) JUDGE JJ
